boundaries: The 27 seed labels are matched policy/environment labels on one base scene and its reflection, not 27 independent scenes.
Action indices are simulator control indices; no conversion to wall-clock or video time is supported.
Requested-cone entry can be transient and is not pickup, transport, detached release, success, or language understanding.
Two behavioral failures entered the requested cone; 104 first entries must not be reported as 104 successes (the retained cohort has 102 successes).
Goal termination occurs at or just after all 13 transient entries, so no post-entry dwell or common-450 sustained-entry claim is supported.
The analysis does not complete A5/A6/A7, score forecast accuracy, supply annotations, or pass a confirmation gate.
No coordinate is interpolated, extrapolated, or carried forward after an episode ends.

sustained_entry_audit.scope: Trace-status audit only. Goal-terminated transient entries do not retain a common three-sample post-entry window and are not assigned an action-450 event time.

definitions.administrative_censoring: No observed primary event contributes action 450 only when the episode is explicitly right-censored at the common 450-action cap. It remains a censored observation, not an event.
definitions.event_time_ecdf: Kaplan-Meier event CDF over the 27 fixed seed labels in a condition. The only primary-endpoint censoring is administrative at action 450, after all observed entry events.
definitions.matched_estimand: For each seed s, [U(position_mirrored,RIGHT)-U(position_mirrored,LEFT)] - [U(control,RIGHT)-U(control,LEFT)], where U is restricted waiting actions. Positive means position reflection increases the RIGHT-vs-LEFT entry delay.
definitions.primary_event: First retained state-sample action index inside the requested cone.
definitions.requested_region: Robot-base horizontal object-minus-reference vector inside the requested 45-degree cone: +delta_y for LEFT, -delta_y for RIGHT, nonzero horizontal distance.
definitions.restricted_waiting_actions: min(T, 450) for the primary first-entry endpoint. For a cap-censored cell, 450 is an RMST-style restricted contribution and not an imputed entry time.
definitions.sustained_entry: Start index of the first run of three consecutive requested-cone samples. Reported as a trace-status audit, not a common-horizon time estimand.

difference_in_differences_actions.description: Position-mirrored RIGHT-minus-LEFT restricted waiting minus control RIGHT-minus-LEFT restricted waiting.
